'''HN Group Private Wiki''' is HN Group's private encyclopedia. It is completely separate from the public HN Group Wiki: nothing on one appears on the other. Every page needs an HN Group sign-in, and only the system owner, owner-level accounts and Super Admin members can edit.

Company articles here are made and kept up to date from the [https://private.companies.hngroup.org.uk Private Company Register]: when a company is added or changed there, its article and the lists below change too.
